abstract: Hostinger is a low-cost host with fast results in a named test and a long AI list. It needs a 48-month term for the sale price, and renewals cost more.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: All About Cookies reported 100% uptime over 9 days and a 138 ms average response time. It also noted that Hostinger is not PCI compliant and that renewals cost more.
Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99 a month, according to Hostinger's own pages.
In the All About Cookies test, a paid plan scored 99 out of 100 on page speed from three locations.
Hostinger is an established host with a 30-day money-back guarantee listed. Read the term and renewal price before you buy.
It lists an AI website builder, AI credits, an AI assistant called Hostinger Agent and an MCP server. We did not test them.
